name: editSharedWidgetData

parameters.name: widget_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget

parameters.name: public_data
parameters.description: New public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes; pass an empty string to remove the public data

parameters.name: cache_time
parameters.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds that the public data of the widget may be cached client-side; 5-3600. If omitted, then the current value is kept, which is 30 by default.

description: Use this method to edit public data of a shared widget created by the bot. A shared widget can be edited at most once per second. On success, True is returned.
